transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK, we're live. Harness bracket, we need 12 by 10/5 for the build. Gwen's team says expediting is possible. Is it worth paying for, or do we eat the slip?

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: If it slips we lose the whole harness day. I'd say pay it, but it's not my money!!

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: hmm depends how much. what does the supplier say about the normal ship

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: They don't. Radio silence. Alright, I'll take it offline.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: On the rig side, cycle count on the second sample is steady. No change in the torque ripple.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good. Andre, dyno?

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: dyno ran the three speed points yesterday. temps looked ok, but the torque sensor zero drifted a bit, i rezeroed it after each run

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: *drifted about a hair, nothing crazy

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Is the drift in the amp or the sensor? Because if it's the sensor I want to swap it.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: not sure yet. leaning sensor, the cable is also kinda pinched

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: I'll re-route the cable. It's rubbing on the frame.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Assembly update, I finished two of the subassemblies, third is waiting on a washer 😬 should be done by lunch 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK. Luis not here yet?

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: He texted, running late.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: hii sorry im here, my mic was muted

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: *late and muted lol

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Luis, the cover plates. Did you get them deburred?

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: yeah all done, i left them on the cart by the sink, a couple had burrs on the inside edge i redid

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ok so fixtures. i got the base plate for the cmm fixture machined, still needs the pins. dmitri when do you need it by again

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Yes, bracket CMM fixture, 1 by 10/14. The CMM slot is booked and I'm not losing it!!

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: And the retainer, 12 by 10/8. If we don't have the retainer in time, we can't close up the test article.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Nothing on the dock for either one yet, I looked this morning.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Is that the same retainer from the last order, or a new design?

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Same. No change.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: also FL-TST-2789, i need 1 by 10/5 for the test, otherwise i cant finish the clamp setup

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Noted. Zoe, ask about that one when you ask about the retainer.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ok, will do, nxt wk, no, today

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: One more thing. The part, 1 by 10/14, same date as the CMM fixture, so let's chase them together.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Got it. I'll write it on the whiteboard.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: fyi chamber door gasket is peeling again

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Tape it for now. Done here, thanks!
